XMLDB.COMMENT: AWS Bedrock provider per-action audit tables.

TABLE.NAME: aiprovider_awsbr_embed_text
TABLE.COMMENT: Per-call audit for the custom embed_text action. Each row supplies a unique actionid so ai_action_register's UNIQUE(actionname, actionid) holds. Renamed from aiprovider_bedrock_embed_text when the plugin was renamed for Moodle plugin repository conflict.

FIELD.NAME: prompt
FIELD.COMMENT: The text that was embedded (may be truncated by caller).

FIELD.NAME: prompttokens
FIELD.COMMENT: Tokens billed for the embedding request.

FIELD.NAME: responseid
FIELD.COMMENT: AWS request ID for the call.

TABLE.NAME: aiprovider_awsbr_grade_resp
TABLE.COMMENT: Per-call audit for the custom grade_response action. Stores token counts and a hash of the prompt, never the prompt text. Each row supplies a unique actionid so ai_action_register's UNIQUE(actionname, actionid) holds.

FIELD.NAME: cachereadtokens
FIELD.COMMENT: Input tokens read from the prompt cache.

FIELD.NAME: cachewritetokens
FIELD.COMMENT: Input tokens written to the prompt cache.

FIELD.NAME: responseid
FIELD.COMMENT: AWS request ID for the call.
